title: [Lean] Compose typed admissible tapes and write supports
body:
## Result and coverage

Author-checked source context: main 0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea, kappa = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918. This PR changes no numerical bound.

This standalone Init-only Lean component proves nine reusable facts for arbitrary label-indexed admissible finite tapes: forward/backward domain propagation, separate one-sided inverse composition, and write-support union/spectator preservation. It derives global facts from local primitive laws; no whole-tape inverse or spectator equation is assumed.

Finite coverage: arbitrary finite chronological tapes, rather than a selected-instance census.
Conditional-interface coverage: applications provide matching primitive domains, local closure/inverse laws, and local write-support laws. Empty domains do not certify an application.
Full-theorem coverage: no full multiplication, physical allocation, byte parser, rounded arithmetic or bit-complexity theorem is claimed.

## Existing checked evidence and reproduction

Exact source SHA256 92cccf6c04267d79a6495c58c4dd63dac2834b53decda477511e1ac4c33be7a4 compiled unchanged in 0.458179662 seconds with official Lean 4.21.0 and its 317-module Init closure. All nine probes and both printed types were independently reviewed: eight facts are axiom-free; support-union associativity uses propext. No warnings. Independent terminal SHA256 a74c6ec3f644d9a792e1d138b717bc56274df1ce418fc6516c9e96bd41f7305b. Source headers retain their historical preparation wording; included receipts record subsequent acceptance.

Compile AdmissibleTypedTape.lean directly with the pinned toolchain as described in the README. No Mathlib, installer, retained private research objects or private paths are required for reproduction. Evidence paths are historical provenance. This package reuses accepted evidence without an additional pre-submission compiler or CI run. Check candidate CI after submission; generic repository workflows are not a fresh Lean replay.

## Attribution and overlap

James Chang with OpenAI assistance; repository Apache-2.0. Preserve Hanson Sun PR1530 and PR590/597 ordered-interpreter motivation. Related PR896 (merged, head 4e34d42b) proves a specialized nonlinear commutator inverse/restoration and ordered-product result; PR612 (open, head ce37f3ce) covers selected R420 B-XOR interfaces. Their inverse/spectator ideas overlap conceptually, but the bounded exact-source comparison found no equivalent arbitrary domain-indexed tape and generic write-support interface. This is not an exhaustive novelty claim; no specialized sources are copied.
